generatedWith: built-in image_gen using approved pixel-v4 style; sharp alpha isolation, fixed anatomical registration and nearest-neighbor packing

alphaIsolation.method: Remove generated transparency matting below alpha 200; keep original RGB and make the retained sprite opaque. Original PNGs are retained unchanged.

frames.anchorMethod: Reference stance-center ground point hand registered from the anatomical planted feet in source frame 0; the same stationary sole/hoof pattern is registered by integer translation in a fixed 22px lower-foot ROI. All four frames use one shared source canvas relative to that anatomical anchor and one stageScale. No per-frame bbox centering, weighted foot centroid or resizing.

footprint.supportSelection: Golden toes/webbing RGB r>=100,g>=45,r>g,b<=0.7g, plus one-pixel outline; excludes low feather hem.
